content.title: Warning Signs of Colon Cancer You Should Never Ignore
content.text: Colon cancer rates are on the rise and it is now the number one cause of cancer death in young people between the ages of 20 to 49. In this video, we go over the very subtle symptoms and signs of colon cancer that you should never ignore, as early detection is key to increasing your chances of survival.
